title: 'Failed to find Server Action' errors when Next.js runs on more than one container or after a deploy
symptoms: Error: Failed to find Server Action "7f3a...". This request might be from an older or newer deployment.
Form submissions fail intermittently behind a load balancer
Users with a tab open from before a deploy get errors on every action
cause: Each build generates its own action IDs and a random key for encrypting action closures. Instances built separately, or old browser tabs against a new build, cannot resolve or decrypt each other's actions.
fix: Build once and run the same artifact everywhere, set the same NEXT_SERVER_ACTIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY at build time on every build, and set deploymentId so stale clients do a hard reload.
affected: Self-hosted Next.js 14 to 16 with multiple instances or rolling deploys
